notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat.
